purpose: Independent concept replication of the dead EQ_H3_AFTERNOON_RELATIVE_REVERSAL idea using a disjoint stock universe and non-overlapping earlier time windows. This cannot rescue or revive the original family ID.

data.universe_rationale: Disjoint matched-sector replication set: large-cap technology, semiconductor, financials and energy. No overlap with AAPL/NVDA/JPM/XOM.
data.gap_policy: No interpolation, forward fill, substitute bar or alternate timestamp. Every required minute for all four names and SPY must exist exactly.

windows.future_shadow_earliest: after D0 and D3 both survive; never before branch freeze

execution.portfolio: one equal-gross market-neutral long/short pair per eligible session; +0.5 long and -0.5 short, gross exposure 1.0, net exposure 0
execution.ranking_metric: log(stock 14:00 close / stock 10:00 open) - log(SPY 14:00 close / SPY 10:00 open)
execution.selection: long lowest metric, short highest metric across the four-stock universe
execution.reversed_same_decision_control: swap long and short at identical ranking/entry/exit timestamps and identical friction

leave_one_name_out.method: For each of MSFT,AMD,BAC,CVX, remove that name, rerank remaining three using the identical metric and timestamps, and recompute primary net mean.
